tributes.name: Captain Steve
tributes.message: Shubham, you were truly the Tony Stark of our engineering unit. Whenever we faced an insurmountable problem, you answered all questions with calm brilliant solutions. Farewell legend!

tributes.name: Natasha R.
tributes.message: Thank you for never ever making me feel silly when asking simple questions. Your patience and zero-judgment shield empowered me so much. We'll miss you 3000!

tributes.name: Bruce B.
tributes.message: Your positivity was infectious! Whenever our servers crashed or code broke, you brought 3000% optimism and turned chaos into a celebration of learning.

jugaadHacks.title: The 2-Line Miracle Transform
jugaadHacks.description: When the legacy API started returning mismatched date structures 10 minutes before demo, everyone panicked. Shubham casually smiled, dropped a 2-line array reduce Jugaad, and saved the entire demo!
jugaadHacks.shubhamQuote: If it's stupid and it works cleanly without side effects, it's a Tony Stark Masterpiece! 🚀

jugaadHacks.title: The Zero-Downtime Cache Patch
jugaadHacks.description: Server memory was spiking during peak stress tests. Instead of a 3-day server overhaul, Shubham introduced a clever client-side memoization Jugaad method that cut load times by 80% instantly.
jugaadHacks.shubhamQuote: Why rebuild the entire engine when a clever spark plug tweak gets us flying at Mach 3? ⚡

poems.title: The Arc Reactor of Wisdom
poems.author: Dedicated to Shubham
verses: In a sea of questions, complex and wide,
He stood as our anchor, our steady guide.
No query too simple, no puzzle too grand,
He helped every thinker to understand.
With a mind like Stark and a heart so kind,
A gentler mentor you'll never find.
He lit up the shadows with words so bright,
And turned every obstacle into light.
